description: One end of a discovered relationship, addressed by plugin-owned identity within the reporting plugin and auth link. Exactly one of `pluginRouteId` (a route), `groupPluginRouteId` (a group route), `endpointId` or `groupId` must be set.

pluginRouteId.description: The plugin route ID of a route reported in the same or an earlier synchronization.

groupPluginRouteId.description: The plugin route ID of a group route reported in the same or an earlier synchronization.

endpointId.description: The full ID of an endpoint owned by the reporting principal.

groupId.description: The full ID of a group owned by the reporting principal.
